chapter.heading: The Loveless Church
chapter.v:
“To the
angel of the church of Ephesus write,‘These things says He who holds the seven stars in His right hand, who walks in the midst of the seven golden lampstands: [Rev. 1:16]

and you
have persevered and have patience, and have labored for My name’s sake and have not become weary. [Gal. 6:9; Heb.]

Nevertheless I
have this against you, that you have left your first love.

Remember therefore
from where you have fallen; repent and do the first works, or else I will come to you quickly and remove your lampstand from its place—unless you repent. [Matt. 21:41]

But this
you have, that you hate the deeds of the Nicolaitans, which I also hate.

“He who
has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says to the churches. To him who overcomes I will give to eat from the tree of life, which is in the midst of the Paradise of God.” ’The Persecuted Church [Matt. 11:15;]

“And to
the angel of the church in Smyrna write,‘These things says the First and the Last, who was dead, and came to life: [Rev. 1:8, 17,]

“I know
your works, tribulation, and poverty (but you are rich); and I know the blasphemy of those who say they are Jews and are not, but are a synagogue of Satan. [Luke 12:21]

Do not
fear any of those things which you are about to suffer. Indeed, the devil is about to throw some of you into prison, that you may be tested, and you will have tribulation ten days. Be faithful until death, and I will give you the crown of life. [Matt. 10:22]

“He who
has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says to the churches. He who overcomes shall not be hurt by the second death.” ’The Compromising Church [Rev. 13:9]

“And to
the angel of the church in Pergamos write,‘These things says He who has the sharp two-edged sword: [Is. 49:2 $;]

“I know
your works, and where you dwell, where Satan’s throne is. And you hold fast to My name, and did not deny My faith even in the days in which Antipas was My faithful martyr, who was killed among you, where Satan dwells.

But I
have a few things against you, because you have there those who hold the doctrine of Balaam, who taught Balak to put a stumbling block before the children of Israel, to eat things sacrificed to idols, and to commit sexual immorality. [Num. 31:16]

Thus you
also have those who hold the doctrine of the Nicolaitans, which thing I hate.

Repent, or
else I will come to you quickly and will fight against them with the sword of My mouth. [Is. 11:4;]

“He who
has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says to the churches. To him who overcomes I will give some of the hidden manna to eat. And I will give him a white stone, and on the stone a new name written which no one knows except him who receives it. ” ’The Corrupt Church [Ex. 16:33, 34;]

“And to
the angel of the church in Thyatira write,‘These things says the Son of God, who has eyes like a flame of fire, and His feet like fine brass: [Rev. 1:14,]

“I know
your works, love, service, faith, and your patience; and as for your works, the last are more than the first. [Rev. 2:2 9 NU,]

Nevertheless I
have a few things against you, because you allow that woman Jezebel, who calls herself a prophetess, to teach and seduce My servants to commit sexual immorality and eat things sacrificed to idols. [1 Kin. 16:31;]

And I
gave her time to repent of her sexual immorality, and she did not repent. [Rom. 2:5;]

Indeed I
will cast her into a sickbed, and those who commit adultery with her into great tribulation, unless they repent of their deeds.

I will
kill her children with death, and all the churches shall know that I am He who searches the minds and hearts. And I will give to each one of you according to your works. [Ps. 7:9; 26:2;]

“Now to
you I say, and to the rest in Thyatira, as many as do not have this doctrine, who have not known the depths of Satan, as they say, I will put on you no other burden.

But hold
fast what you have till I come.

And he
who overcomes, and keeps My works until the end, to him I will give power over the nations—

‘Heshall rule
them with a rod of iron;They shall be dashed to pieces like the potter’s vessels’ —as I also have received from My Father;

and I
will give him the morning star. [2 Pet. 1:19;]

“He who
has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says to the churches.” ’
